column7: SuspendProjectSecretsWithOptions decided the project-wide suspend per secret only (enforceSecretWriteGate), so a project viewer holding a per-secret ACL write could suspend those secrets through a direct core call while REST refused them (authzdiff known-04, row 25 of #4161). Core now calls requireScopedGate(secrets.write, project) before any secret is read or written; a refusal suspends, marks and audits nothing. Defence in depth: REST already refused and there is no gRPC method. Fixed in #4655
